claims.text: Acitretin = chemoprevention for nonmelanoma skin CA in solid organ transplant recipients
claims.quote: Acitretin is a chemoprevention measure for nonmelanoma skin cancers in solid organ transplants.

claims.text: Renal transplant RCT: acitretin 30 mg/day for six months cut new SCCs to 11% vs 47% w placebo
claims.quote: In a double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in renal transplant recipients, acitretin 30 mg/day for six months reduced the incidence of new SCCs to 11% versus 47% with placebo
claims.locator: Chemoprevention in Skin Cancer: What Advice? (Cancers (Basel), 2026)
